dropped.finding: test_git_helper_commits_are_reachable_from_head cannot detect the regression it purports to guard: it asserts only `git rev-parse HEAD` returncode == 0, but build_scratch_rebar_repo already creates an 'init' commit, so HEAD is resolvable whether or not write_project_prompt commits. If write_project_prompt regressed to skipping its commit (the exact baa8 defect), this test would still pass. It never asserts the written prompt's blob is reachable from HEAD.
dropped.suggested_fix: Replace the bare `rev-parse HEAD` returncode assertion with a check that the prompt path resolves in HEAD's tree, e.g. run `git -C repo cat-file -e HEAD:.rebar/prompts/some-prompt.md` and assert returncode == 0 (fails when the file is left uncommitted).
